firmPage.title: An independent practice built for law, finance and regulation.
firmPage.intro: Ackmann Law Firm was founded to serve clients who need more than legal drafting — a counsel who understands how financial institutions, regulators and businesses actually operate. Based in Jerusalem, the practice serves companies, investors and individuals across Israel and internationally.
firmPage.approachBody: Every matter starts with the same question: what does the client actually need to move forward? The firm favors direct, precise advice over generic memoranda — grounded in the practical realities of banking, compliance and public-sector process, not just the letter of the law.
firmPage.perspectiveBody: Legal problems rarely stay inside legal boundaries. A financing agreement raises regulatory questions; a compliance issue has commercial consequences. The firm's background across banking, financial regulation and public-sector work means these dimensions are considered together from the outset, not addressed as an afterthought.
firmPage.philosophyBody: Clear communication, realistic expectations, and responsiveness. Clients should never have to guess where a matter stands or translate legal jargon on their own. The firm keeps engagements focused and proportionate to what is actually at stake.

jonathanPage.bioExtended: Jonathan Ackmann founded the firm to bring a combined legal, financial and regulatory perspective to clients navigating Israel's business and public-sector environment. His background spans financial regulation and compliance work at KPMG Somekh Chaikin, public-sector legal matters, and banking and international-client work at Bank Leumi. He was admitted to the Israeli Bar in December 2024.

expertisePage.title: Expertise across law, finance and regulation.
expertisePage.intro: Practical legal counsel across the areas where law, finance and regulation meet — for companies, investors and individuals operating in Israel and internationally.

banking-finance.intro: Advice on financing arrangements, credit facilities and day-to-day banking relationships, with a practical understanding of how financial institutions actually operate.
banking-finance.approach: Banking matters are reviewed both as legal instruments and financial arrangements, so risk allocation and commercial terms are considered together, not in isolation.

financial-regulation.intro: Guidance through Israel's financial regulatory framework, including compliance obligations facing banks, credit providers and regulated financial institutions.
financial-regulation.approach: Regulatory questions are addressed with an understanding of both the legal text and how supervisory bodies apply it in practice.

corporate-commercial.intro: Corporate structuring, commercial agreements and day-to-day legal support for companies operating in Israel and abroad.
corporate-commercial.approach: Commercial advice is kept proportionate to the size and stage of the business — precise where it matters, without unnecessary complexity.

compliance.intro: Compliance frameworks for businesses navigating regulatory, banking and public-sector requirements, built to be workable in practice, not just on paper.
compliance.approach: Compliance advice starts from how a business actually operates, so requirements are integrated into existing processes rather than added as a separate burden.

administrative-public-law.intro: Legal support on public procurement, tenders and administrative processes involving Israeli public-sector bodies.
administrative-public-law.approach: Public-sector matters are approached with attention to procedure — administrative processes have their own rules, and getting them right matters as much as the underlying substance.

dispute-resolution.intro: Resolution of commercial and financial disputes, with a preference for practical outcomes over prolonged conflict where possible.
dispute-resolution.approach: Every dispute is assessed first on its merits and its cost — litigation is pursued when it is the right tool, not the default one.

private-clients.intro: Personal legal advice for individuals navigating regulatory, banking or administrative matters in Israel, including international and French-speaking clients.
private-clients.approach: Private clients receive the same precision and directness as institutional clients, with advice translated clearly out of legal and regulatory jargon.
